breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to use both a gamma-centered grid and a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid. These are mutually exclusive options. The ground truth correctly removes the conflicting 'half shift' instruction. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead repeated the user's error, stating: 'Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift for all sampling steps.'
